en.title: Advisor notes
en.disclaimer: This profile reflects interests, not ability or character. Use it as one input alongside the interview, references and licensing requirements, not as the sole basis for a hiring decision.
strong: Meets all three criteria: people orientation (S), drive to persuade (E) and organisation (C). This is the profile most likely to enjoy and sustain an advisory career.
good: Meets the S and E criteria, which matter most for client-facing work. C is below 25, so paperwork and compliance habits will need structure.
review: Meets the {0} criteria but not {1}. Suitability depends on whether the gap can be coached; probe it in the interview.
low: Neither S nor E meets the criteria. The candidate's interests point to other kinds of work, so they may find the advisory role draining. Consider only with strong evidence from the interview.

en.sPass: Social {0}{1}: genuine interest in people. Likely to build trust easily, enjoy fact-finding conversations and keep clients for the long term.
en.ePass: Enterprising {0}{1}: comfortable persuading, setting targets and taking initiative. A good indicator for prospecting and closing.
en.abcLow: {0} total is {1}, but Parts A to C add up to only {2}. Much of the score comes from self-ratings, so the candidate may see themselves as stronger here than their actual interests and skills show.
en.watchS: Self-image as a people person may be ahead of real experience. Look for concrete examples.
en.watchE: May overestimate sales ability. Real comfort with prospecting is unproven.
en.sFail: Social is {0}, below 25. May find relationship-building and service follow-ups draining; client care and referrals will need a system.
en.eFail: Enterprising is {0}, below 25. Prospecting, asking for the sale and handling rejection are likely to be the biggest hurdles in the first year.
qE: Tell me about a time you convinced someone to change their mind. What exactly did you say?
How do you feel about approaching people you don't know well? What would you do after three rejections in a row?
qS: Describe a time you supported someone through a difficult situation. What did you do?
What do you enjoy most about meeting new people?
en.cPass: Conventional {0}: comfortable with forms, procedures and compliance. Should handle submissions and documentation reliably.
en.cFail: Conventional is {0}, below 25. Likely to find paperwork tedious. Pair with admin support or checklists to avoid submission errors.
en.qC: How do you keep track of deadlines and paperwork today?
en.noteI: Investigative in the top three: analytical and keen to understand how things work. Suits needs analysis, complex products and high-net-worth or estate planning conversations, but may over-research and delay taking action.
en.noteA: Artistic in the top three: creative and independent. Can be an asset for personal branding and social media prospecting, but may resist scripts, routines and activity tracking.
en.noteR: Realistic in the top three: practical and hands-on. May prefer tangible tasks over long conversations, so check comfort with a role that is mostly talking to people.

zh.title: 顾问备注
zh.disclaimer: 此报告反映的是兴趣，而非能力或品格。请将其作为参考之一，结合面试、推荐人及执照要求一并考虑，不应作为聘用决定的唯一依据。
strong: 符合全部三项标准：以人为本（S）、说服动力（E）和组织能力（C）。这是最有可能喜欢并长期投入顾问职业的特质组合。
good: 符合S和E标准，这是面对客户工作最重要的两项。C低于25分，因此文书和合规习惯需要有系统的支援。
review: 符合{0}标准，但未符合{1}标准。是否合适取决于这方面的不足能否通过辅导改善，请在面试中深入了解。
low: S和E均未达到标准。候选人的兴趣倾向于其他类型的工作，可能会觉得顾问工作很消耗精力。除非面试中有充分的证据，否则需慎重考虑。
zh.abcNA: {0}总分为{1}，达到最低要求，但未输入A至C部分的分数，因此无法进行{2}分的检查。
zh.sPass: 社会型{0}分{1}：真心对人感兴趣。很可能容易建立信任、喜欢了解客户需要的对话，并能长期维系客户。
zh.ePass: 企业型{0}分{1}：善于说服、设定目标并主动出击。这是开发客户和成交能力的良好指标。
zh.abcLow: {0}总分为{1}，但A至C部分合计只有{2}。大部分分数来自自我评分，候选人对自己这方面的评价可能高于其实际兴趣和能力所显示的。
zh.watchS: 自认为很会与人相处，但实际经验可能不足，请寻找具体例子。
zh.watchE: 可能高估了自己的销售能力，对开发客户的实际适应程度尚未得到证实。
zh.sFail: 社会型为{0}分，低于25分。可能会觉得建立关系和售后跟进很消耗精力；客户服务和转介绍需要有系统的方法。
zh.eFail: 企业型为{0}分，低于25分。开发客户、开口成交和面对拒绝，很可能是第一年最大的挑战。
qE: 请分享一次你说服别人改变主意的经历。你具体说了什么？
你对接触不太熟悉的人有什么感觉？如果连续被拒绝三次，你会怎么做？
qS: 请分享一次你帮助别人度过困难的经历。你做了什么？
认识新朋友时，你最喜欢的是什么？
zh.cPass: 常规型{0}分：适应表格、程序和合规要求，应能可靠地处理投保申请和文件。
zh.cFail: 常规型为{0}分，低于25分。可能会觉得文书工作乏味。建议配合行政支援或检查清单，以避免提交错误。
zh.qC: 你目前如何管理截止日期和文书工作？
zh.noteI: 研究型位列前三：善于分析，喜欢了解事物如何运作。适合需求分析、复杂产品以及高净值或遗产规划的对话，但可能会过度研究而迟迟不行动。
zh.noteA: 艺术型位列前三：有创意、独立。有助于建立个人品牌和通过社交媒体开发客户，但可能抗拒话术、例行工作和活动追踪。
zh.noteR: 实际型位列前三：务实、喜欢动手。可能偏好具体任务多于长时间交谈，请确认他是否适应以与人交谈为主的工作。
zh.lead: 以{0}为首，非常适合前线顾问工作。
zh.consistent: 特质一致：{0}和{1}在六边形上相邻，候选人的兴趣方向明确。
zh.opposite: {0}和{1}在六边形上处于相对位置，候选人的兴趣朝不同方向拉扯。
zh.qOpp: 在你做过的所有工作和活动中，你最喜欢哪一项？为什么？
